notes: Route: robots.txt permissive (User-agent * Allow: /, only Amazonbot etc. training bots Disallowed) -> WordPress REST API /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?_fields=link,date&per_page=100&after=2026-09-24T00:00:00&before=2026-10-26T00:00&page=N (1-day local-time margin each side for the site's +03:00 tz). All responses HTTP 200. 8 pages (775 rows, last page 97) in ~7s. Listed date = the YYYY/MM/DD in the article URL path /news/YYYY/MM/DD/<id>/; it equals the REST local 'date' for 775/775 rows (0 mismatches) and equals the page JSON-LD datePublished date-part on 4 random re-fetches (2026-10-07/1120221, 2026-09-30/1119535, 2026-10-10/1120488, 2026-10-21/1121444; all HTTP 200, 50k-66k chars of text). Yoast sitemaps (wp-sitemap.xml -> post-sitemapN.xml) exist but their <lastmod> is post-modified time, so REST 'date' + URL path was preferred. Result: 775 unique URLs, all 31 days covered, target days 2026-09-30=30, 2026-10-10=25, 2026-10-20=29 (all >=15). Output data/urls_custom/palinfo-com.tsv, no header, URL<TAB>YYYY-MM-DD, deduplicated.
